fields.label: Product / batch run
fields.help: What was produced today (leave blank if no production)

sections.title: 1. Pre-Operation Cleanliness Check
sections.description: Before production starts, following cleaning and sanitation, confirm each surface/equipment is visibly clean and sanitized (SQF 11.2.5.7). Mark Pass (clean/sanitized) or Fail; note any corrective action taken before start-up. Add or remove items as the line changes.

sections.title: 2. Production Equipment — Cleaned & Sanitized per SSOP
sections.description: For each machine used in today's production, confirm it was verified clean and sanitized per its SSOP and recorded on its own cleaning log, or mark "Not used today". Add or remove equipment as the line changes.

sections.title: 3. Detergent & Sanitizer Verification
sections.description: Confirm and record detergent and sanitizer concentration before use (SQF 11.2.5.3). Site chemicals: Dawn Professional detergent at 1-2 oz per 10 gallons of water; Noble Sani-512 sanitizer at the food-contact dilution of 1:512 (1 fl oz per 4 gallons, about 200 ppm quat).

fields.label: Detergent concentration
fields.help: Per the manufacturer's instructions - Dawn Professional is 1-2 oz per 10 gallons of water

fields.label: Detergent test method
fields.help: How the dose was measured - pump strokes, measuring cup or proportioner. The Dawn Professional pump delivers 1 oz per full stroke.

sections.title: 4. Glass & Brittle Plastic Check
sections.description: At the start of the shift, confirm glass instrument dial covers and MIG thermometers are undamaged (SQF 11.7.3.4). Mark Pass (undamaged), Fail (damaged/broken), or N/A. Any Fail requires a Glass Breakage Incident Report (FRM-908) and follows SOP-11.7.3. Items are drawn from the Glass & Brittle Plastic Register (FRM-907).

sections.title: 5. Operational GMP Check
sections.description: During production, confirm operational GMPs are being followed. Mark Pass, Fail, or N/A; note corrective action for any Fail (absorbs the former FRM-904 Daily Operation Check).

labels: Hair/beard nets worn; no exposed jewelry
Clean outer garments; no eating/drinking/gum in production
Hands washed on entry and as required
No condensation or drip over exposed product
Pest control devices in place and intact

sections.title: 6. Corrective Actions & Release
sections.description: Production shall not begin until all non-conformances are corrected and the area is verified clean (SOP-11.2.12). A record of pre-operational hygiene inspection is maintained for a minimum of 12 months (SQF 11.2.5.9).

fields.label: All corrective actions completed before start-up
QA Technician (qualified inspector)
fields.statement: I inspected the area and equipment before start of production, verified the sanitizer concentration, and confirm the area is clean and released for production (or corrective action was completed as noted).

fields.label: Production Supervisor
fields.statement: I confirm the pre-operation inspection was completed and the area is released for production.
